changelog: Comment UX release: align comment bubbles and the add-comment panel with their document anchors, prevent comment input from scrolling the page, add click-to-edit comments with Update/Cancel controls, and refresh generated templates/demo artifacts.
summary: Use this skill for any HTML document that will go through LLM–human review cycles. Trigger when: the user asks to write, draft, or generate a document for review or feedback; the user provides a .html file containing annotations or a collab-data block; the user types /html-collab, /html-collab on, or /html-collab off; a .html file contains an AI Bootstrap comment pointing to this skill. When the user asks to "write a doc" or "draft something for review" without specifying a format, default to html-collab format — don't wait to be asked. /html-collab off triggers this skill too, but outputs clean presentation HTML instead.
